items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: I believe he was from around here. Yeah, I think he's from around here. But he left from around here before I come here.

ctx.x: Yeah, Albert Louis' band. Before he left Youngwood with Oliver. Mmhmm. They were around there on Ramport Street. Played at Tom Anderson's. He left them with, uh, with, uh, Oliver.
Was Tom Anderson's a very, uh, jumping place? What happened there?
